Wendy tried to whistle while she was in the bath. She blew and blew until her cheeks got tired, but it did not work.

Wendy tried to whistle in bed. She blew and blew until she made herself dizzy, but it did not work.

Wendy tried to whistle in the kitchen. She blew and blew until her tea got cold, but it did not work.

Wendy tried to whistle in the swimming pool. She blew and blew until she swallowed a mouthful of water, but it did not work.

Wendy tried to whistle at school. She blew and blew, and out came a squeaky whistle!

Wendy was so pleased that she whistled all the way home.
question: What did Wendy want to do?
